$comment: SessionStart nudges for a session started in THIS repo. The hook scripts themselves live once, at the workspace root, and are versioned in capucor-docs/workspace-root/dot-claude/hooks/. This file only points at them; it deliberately holds no logic, no secret and no absolute local path.

WHY IT EXISTS: Claude Code does not read settings.json from parent directories. Measured 2026-08-25 - a headless session started in this repo ran ZERO SessionStart hooks while a session started at the workspace root ran the root's. Most work happens here, so the nudges never reached the place they were written for, and Phase 2 ran 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-25 with no board row for any of it.

THE ../ ESCAPES THIS REPOSITORY, ON PURPOSE. If the workspace is ever restructured so that capucor-web/ is not a direct child of the folder holding .claude/hooks/, bash cannot find the script and the nudge dies with no error. That path is pinned in contracts/cross-repo-contract.json under fixedPaths so `npm run audit` fails instead of going quiet.

The scripts also root-anchor themselves by walking up to the capucor-docs/ sentinel, so they read the workspace-root copies of the board and AGENTS.md rather than this repo's. Both halves are needed: this file makes the hook RUN, the walk-up makes it READ THE RIGHT FILE.

capucor-webpage is a PUBLIC repository. This file is committed and a stranger can read it. It therefore holds no secret, no token, no project id and no absolute local path - only a relative path and the reasoning above. Keep it that way.
